title: 我决心做3A: 01/65
description:
*****Before purchasing: This game only contains one mini-game (2D side-scrolling gameplay), which lasts approximately 2 to 5 hours (depending on whether you pursue collectibles). It is not a fully-fledged game in the traditional sense; rather, it's the first part of a series of "components" designed to fundraise (for developing my 3A). Its non-essential features (such as options settings, UI, and almost everything outside of the mini-game world) are of low completion. I strongly recommend anyone to watch its trailer before purchasing*****



While I'm still young, I just want to give it a try, even if it might cost me the rest of my life.
description_short: My name is Bao Qiang, I have two dreams: 1st, to make the first "Civic 3A" in the world. 2nd, to change the entire game industry. But players, I need your help.
